candidates.claim: The read-only SNMP community on rtr-01 is configured with no ACL, although the management policy requires SNMP communities to be restricted by an ACL that permits only MGMT hosts.
candidates.remediation: Bind an ACL that permits only 10.10.99.50 (such as SNMP_NMS) to the rtr-01 read-only SNMP community.

candidates.claim: The rtr-01 snmp-server community line differs from the approved baseline: the baseline binds it to ACL SNMP_NMS, while the current configuration has no ACL.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the rtr-01 SNMP community change with the approved baseline and restore the SNMP_NMS binding, or document an approved exception.
